longestGapArithmetic.name: previous completed evaluation to next absolute pricing eligibility
longestGapArithmetic.interpretation: Reference cadence interval remaining after the previous evaluation; not processing delay.

longestGapArithmetic.name: pricing eligible to reported pricing job selection
longestGapArithmetic.interpretation: Includes the admitted second enrichment waiting/operating plus the unseparated completion-to-dispatch interval.

longestGapArithmetic.name: reported pricing job selection to physical HTTP invocation
longestGapArithmetic.interpretation: Dominated by the mandatory1s spacing after the preceding enrichment; remaining local preparation/persistence is not separately instrumented.

longestGapArithmetic.name: physical HTTP invocation to completed response body
longestGapArithmetic.interpretation: Measured request/response wall interval; proxy, network and provider portions are not separable.

longestGapArithmetic.name: response body available to account snapshot receipt
longestGapArithmetic.interpretation: Includes JSON/result delivery, budget bookkeeping and caller snapshot capture; substeps are uninstrumented.

longestGapArithmetic.name: account snapshot receipt to completed three-holding evaluation
longestGapArithmetic.interpretation: SDK decoding/quotes, same-byte independent parity, recording and use checks combined; this is NOT an isolated parity-duration measurement.
